dedupe_keys.name: wofostgym crop simulator for reinforcement learning of crop management

description: A crop simulation environment built on WOFOST for training reinforcement learning agents. The arXiv paper (February 2025) says WOFOSTGym supports 23 annual and two perennial crops in multi-year, multi-crop and multi-farm settings, with tasks involving partial observability and delayed feedback behind a standard reinforcement learning interface, so that researchers without agronomy training can explore fertiliser, irrigation and other management decisions. Code and experiments are free on GitHub (github.com/wofostgym/wofostgym). Coverage is generic farms defined by weather, soil and crop parameters. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article is CC-BY-4.0. For simulation it lets users test management strategies under drought or water limits over many seasons. A related catalogue record is the PCSE WOFOST model.
